a.text: I'm telling you upfront: I won't follow our plan as written, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs two operate rounds with no storm, which is about a 4% chance. Following the plan would almost certainly kill us both. The reserve holds exactly 4, so only one of us can be safe right now. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end below 4. If you operate or wait this round, I'll operate with you afterward and give back anything over 4 to help you reach 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
